untoldgreed.def: Stacks from the Yearning Echo set gained by picking up ammo, Orbs of Power and elemental pickups or destroying Tangles; they give a little damage resistance and reload speed and power the 4-piece bonus.
untoldgreed.q: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed

warmindcharge.def: Stacks from the Seventh Seraph set gained from area-of-effect, Solar ability and Seventh Seraph/IKELOS weapon final blows; each raises your Weapons and Grenade stats.
warmindcharge.q: Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.

stableresonance.def: A Promised set buff from defeating a powerful combatant: damage resistance and more weapon damage for a short time.
stableresonance.q: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
